thread:
Maya (CS): Hey team — Northstar underwriting just requested a domain-chat model for clause parsing and Q&A. They want: low-latency chat, deterministic citeable answers, and strict data residency (EU). Also asking about HSM for key storage. Can we scope onboarding?

Raj (Solutions Eng): Thanks — can you paste the customer note/POC requirements? model size preference? dedicated vs private?

Maya (CS): Copy from customer: "We need a model that can read policy PDFs, extract clause references, cite source pages, and answer follow-ups without hallucinating. Must keep data in EU and use our HSM for keys. Target go-live in 6–8 weeks."

Tom (AE): Heads up — renewal in 3mo. If we move to Dedicated/Private now, this could be a seat to lock in renewal. Customer is price-sensitive though.

Anya (Security): EU residency + HSM is doable via Private (VPC + customer-managed KMS/HSM). We need their SOC2/HIPAA posture details and a data flow diagram. Also ask for any PHI/PCI.

Raj (Solutions Eng): Quick technical checklist: 1) model candidate (13B vs 33B), 2) quantization compat, 3) latency SLOs, 4) indexing pipeline for PDFs (embedding store), 5) citation/kernel for source pages. I can draft recommended config.

Maya (CS): They prefer stronger accuracy over raw throughput — suggested 13B instruction-tuned variant if hallucinations are low.

Evals Bot: automated-smoke: run_id=ns-20260405-1 results: exact-match=0.78, cite-precision=0.85, hallucination-rate=0.04, avg-latency=180ms (p95=420ms) against 120 test prompts.

Raj (Solutions Eng): Nice — hallucination 4% looks good. Can you share sample prompt set and eval harness? Also, we'll want a reranker + citation scorer in the pipeline.

Maya (CS): Attached sample prompts in the intake doc (link). Customer ok with us running evals on their redacted dataset. I'll coordinate export.

Anya (Security): Before evals on customer data: sign NDA addendum and get confirmation of redaction standards. Also need to confirm HSM API (PKCS#11) compatibility.

Tom (AE): I'll push NDA addendum now. Maya — can you add a line item in the renewal forecast for a potential Dedicated upsell? Marking as medium risk if we don't act.

Raj (Solutions Eng): Proposed rollout plan: week1-2 infra + HSM setup (Private), week3-4 evals & tuning, week5 canary with 5% traffic, week6 full cutover. Needs SRE + infra slot.

Maya (CS): Timeline noted. Customer VPC peering requires IP allowlist. I'll collect network contacts.

Evals Bot: sample-run command:
```
./runevals --suite northstar_clauses --model rdl-13b-instruct-q4 --dataset northstar_redacted.jsonl --metrics cite_precision,hallucination,exact_match
```

Raj (Solutions Eng): One more: add automatic prefix caching for repeated clause lookups to save cost. Also recommend token budget 2048.

Anya (Security): Logged security action: create intake ticket #SEC-4489 for HSM review + data residency signoff.

Maya (CS): Action items: 1) Tom send NDA addendum (in flight), 2) Customer send redacted dataset + DF diagram, 3) Raj to provide infra config + cost estimate, 4) Anya to run HSM/residency checklist.

Tom (AE): NDA sent :email: will update when counter-signed.

Raj (Solutions Eng): I'll draft infra config today and post in #eng-platform.

Maya (CS): Thanks all — ping me if blocked. Putting a follow-up in 48h. :rocket:
